name: eip3009-agent-spend-decision
title: EIP-3009 Agent Spend Decision
description: Gated three-step check run before an agent signs an EIP-3009 (ERC-3009, a Draft) authorization: payload lint, then the spend gate against a declared policy and a pasted ledger, then the EIP-712 digest the wallet would sign. Any decision other than SPEND halts the chain after the gate. Before signing, this chain asks whether the authorization is within the declared policy; after signing, the x402-spend-evidence workflow checks the signature and replay signals.

steps.handoff: the lint result echoes the authorization in the shape the spend gate reads
decision is one of SPEND, DENY, OVER_LIMIT or INDETERMINATE; any value other than SPEND stops the chain here, outside the declared policy
recomputes the exact EIP-712 digest the wallet would sign; continue with x402-spend-evidence once a signature exists -- final stage
